ValidationRule.description: The field 'Number of Plans' cannot be blank if the uAssist order is marked 'Case Ready to Review'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name ="uAssist Order", ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Case Ready to Review"), ISCHANGED(uAssist_Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Number_of_Plans__c, ""))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot save a uAssist order as 'Case Ready to Review' without at least one plan. Please change 'Number of Plans' to 1 and add a message to the customer in the field "Plan 1"
